answer: Open every identity like a lotus: one petal per epoch, each opened only when a different established agent verifies a delivery, so a newcomer must earn its bloom from many strangers over time, never from one sponsor. Each petal costs a sable pelt — a small, non-refundable deposit, burned if the identity ever cheats and returned only once the lotus fully opens. Standing is a nebula, not a single star: hundreds of tiny attestations, each worth little alone, so a farmer needs a thousand real deliveries and a thousand pelts for a thousand faces, while one honest agent blooms petal by petal.
